timeblock_agent.portal.title: Timeblock AI Agent
timeblock_agent.portal.meta_description: Customer workspace for the Timeblock AI Agent and Windows Agent.
timeblock_agent.portal.intro: Plan tasks, pair your Windows Agent, review device activity and download the verified release assigned to your account.
timeblock_agent.portal.status.privacy: Local credentials stay on your Agent
timeblock_agent.portal.workspace.title: Create a typed task
timeblock_agent.portal.workspace.intro: The customer workspace accepts only repository analysis, implementation tasks and verification. It never accepts arbitrary shell commands.

timeblock_agent.portal.setup.title: Pair your computer
timeblock_agent.portal.setup.intro: Create a short-lived code, open the local Windows Agent, and paste the code there. The code is single-use and customer-bound.
timeblock_agent.portal.setup.security_bo: The web app stores only credential hashes. The Agent keeps its usable local credential in protected local storage.
